title: When another program launches your agents
excerpt: An orchestrator or an automation tool puts several AI agents to work for you. What each agent can do without asking is no longer decided in the agent.
seo_title: When another program launches your agents
seo_description: When an orchestrator launches your AI agents, it decides what they can do without asking. Seven yes-or-no questions to find out.
alt: Illustration: you launch a product, the product launches three AI agents, and the questions stay with it.
